newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Nice Systems to offer 2.5 million ADSs.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Nice Systems to offer 2.5 million ADSs.

text.p: Israel's Nice Systems Ltd said on Thursday it had filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 2.5 million American depository shares (ADSs).
The lead manager for the offering is Lehman Brothers. Co-managers are Hambrecht & Quist, Oppenheimer and Co and Salomon Brothers, the company said.

Nice, which makes computer telephony integration (CTI) equipment, said proceeds would go towards expanding current operations, working capital and general corporate purposes. The ADSs will represent ordinary shares of Nice.

Nice said it aimed to strengthen its presence in the call centre market by increasing sales, marketing, customer service and product development activities either through internal growth or strategic acquisitions.
Nice also said it had signed a definitive agreement to buy all the outstanding capital stock of Canada's Dees Communications for $8 million in cash and between 435,000 and 500,000 ADSs.
Nice said the acquisition, which was announced in May, is expected to be completed by the end of the third quarter. Dees provides call-monitoring software for the CTI market.
